purpose: Baseline consolidation and information-loss diagnosis; no algorithm promotion
primary_profile: Round31 R: T1_union + fixed C1 + Round29 B curves + UW
secondary_profile: Round31 S: same pool and geometry, fascicle-guided pair ranking
phase_0: Verify and summarize existing artifacts; no new forward passes
phase_1: Frozen T1 checkpoints, save float32 union/sup/deep probability outputs; reproduce native protocol and report binary-mask parity before diagnosis

phase_2.scope: Separate analytic coordinate tests, frozen-mask decoder tests, and image-level network tests
phase_2.preserve: All anatomical content; explicit forward/inverse coordinates; reference pixels transformed only in evaluator
phase_2.inference: Keep original 512 boundary and 1024 fasc inference protocol; never train or calibrate
phase_2.note: Image-level transforms can change sampling/resolution; do not label all differences decoder errors. No inferred ROI crop is introduced.

phase_3: Choose one supported next intervention, without implementing training or a new production rule

evaluation.external: Assumed-units exploratory only; existing reused development set
evaluation.missing: Preserve null, fixed denominator and IDs
evaluation.paired: Actual common IDs per parameter, new/lost separately; never pool seeds as independent images
evaluation.tail_cutoffs: 20/50 assumed mm are inherited descriptive bins, not medical acceptance limits
evaluation.reference_access: Read cached baseline evaluations in phase 0; new inference consumes image-only manifests; diagnosis uses references only after prediction freeze
evaluation.diagnostic_acceptance: Complete attribution with explicit unresolved cases, not mandatory improvement in this no-change round
